# Western New England University

> Western New England University in Springfield, MA offers undergraduate, graduate, law, and pharmacy programs with a focus on experiential learning, student support, and career development.

Western New England University is a comprehensive institution featuring four colleges (Arts & Sciences, Business, Engineering, Pharmacy and Health Sciences) plus a School of Law. The university emphasizes hands-on learning experiences, mentorship, and career services to prepare students for professional success.

## Admissions & Getting Started

- [Admissions](https://www2.wne.edu/admissions/index): Main admissions page for undergraduate, graduate, transfer, and international students.
- [Apply](https://www2.wne.edu/become-a-student/apply/index): Application portal for undergraduate, graduate, law, and pharmacy programs with rolling admissions.
- [Request Information](https://www2.wne.edu/become-a-student/request-info/index): Information request form for prospective students about enrollment and financial aid.
- [Visit Campus](https://www2.wne.edu/become-a-student/visit/index): Campus visit scheduling and virtual tours for undergraduate, graduate, law, and pharmacy programs.

## Academic Programs

- [Academics Overview](https://www2.wne.edu/academics/index): Overview of academic programs, degrees, and educational opportunities.
- [Undergraduate Programs](https://www2.wne.edu/academics/undergraduate/index): Catalog of 50 undergraduate majors across four colleges.
- [Graduate Programs](https://www2.wne.edu/academics/graduate/index): Master's, doctoral, and combined degree programs across multiple colleges.
- [Colleges & Schools](https://www2.wne.edu/academics/colleges/index): Overview of four colleges and school of law with academic offerings.
- [Academic Departments](https://www2.wne.edu/academics/academic-departments): Directory of academic departments and programs across colleges.
- [Honors Program](https://www2.wne.edu/academics/honors/index): Selective honors program for students in Arts & Sciences, Business, and Engineering.

## Why Western New England

- [Why WNE?](https://www2.wne.edu/become-a-student/why-wne/index): Overview of Western New England's educational value and unique student experience.
- [Unique Learning Experiences](https://www2.wne.edu/become-a-student/why-wne/unique-learning-experiences): Details on experiential learning including internships, trading room, and entrepreneurship.
- [Attention to Students](https://www2.wne.edu/become-a-student/why-wne/attention): Information on small class sizes, mentorship, and SOAR orientation program.
- [Student Support](https://www2.wne.edu/become-a-student/why-wne/support): Overview of student support services including tutoring, advising, and career development.
- [Campus Facilities](https://www2.wne.edu/become-a-student/why-wne/campus): Description of 215-acre Springfield campus facilities and infrastructure.
